The first-move extension spectrum S_G(x) depends only on seven intrinsic classes: identity, unique involution, order3, unrooted/rooted order4 and unrooted/rooted other order; exceptional n=2 generic diagram handled separately. The class-presence conditions are exactly n=2,3,4 singleton special and, for n>=5, independent indicators 3|n,4|n. Independently reconstructed full multiplication-relational diagrams over every ordered group pair for 2<=n<=34, recovering the same seven types. Source distinct checkers cover n<=56 and n<=100.
